title: Fix All Policy Breachs in Semio Cli Main Go First Half
description: Fix DEFINITION-MISSING-SUMMARY, DEFINITION-MISSING-SPECS, SECTION-MISSING-SUMMARY, and SECTION-ORPHAN-DEFINITION breachs in the first half (lines 1-15000) of semio-repo/cli/main.go
summary: Fixed 842 policy breachs in the first half (lines 1-15000) of semio-repo/cli/main.go: added Preamble section for orphan package/import, added 35 section summaries, added ~500 definition summaries, added ~300 func requirements with RFC 2119 keywords, removed 1 incorrect inline comment. Total breachs reduced from 1515 to 673. Build passes, all tests pass.
